## Scope and issue links

- Issue(s):
- Summary and user impact:
- Compatibility / breaking changes / migration:
- Security, permissions, data handling and rollback:

## Definition of done

- [ ] Followed docs/HA_ENGINEERING_STANDARD.md and applicable official HA rules.
- [ ] Meaningful docstrings for all new/changed Python definitions and inline rationale where needed.
- [ ] Type annotations, async/lifecycle behavior, stable IDs and error handling reviewed.
- [ ] Tests cover changed behavior and failure paths; synthetic data only.
- [ ] README, architecture, translations and changelog updated or not applicable with reason.
- [ ] Manifest/HACS versioning, minimum HA compatibility and release impacts reviewed.
- [ ] Privacy, security and license/attribution reviewed.
- [ ] All findings recorded in GitHub and docs/AUDIT_REGISTER.md; no unrelated findings silently closed.
- [ ] Mandatory CI and regression checks passed on exact head SHA.

## Evidence

List commands, tool/dependency versions, outcomes and checks not performed. Include exact commit SHA and test/install/rollback evidence if relevant. Do not include live tokens or personal data.
